test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per a study published in Acta Astronautica in September 2021, with which institute did ISRO develop an instrument to conduct microbial experiments in outer space?

options.text: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay)

solution:
The correct answer is **__Indian Institute of Science (IISc).__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Acta Astronautica**

 
 
• **M​monthly peer-reviewed scientific journal **covering all **fields of physical, engineering, life, and social sciences **related to the **peaceful scientific exploration of space.**
 
• Known as **one of the top aerospace engineering journals.**
 
 
 
• **IISc**
 
 
• **Public, deemed, research university** for **higher education and research in science, engineering, design, and management.**
 
• **Located in Bengaluru, in the Indian state of Karnataka.**** **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO**

 
 
• The** Indian Space Research Organization** is the **national space agency of India, headquartered in Bangalore.**
 
• **It operates under the Department of Space** which is **directly overseen by the Prime Minister of India**, while **the Chairman of ISRO acts as the executive of DOS.**
